name: substitution-swap
intent: Primary target collapses through a decoy-only mid-state (hold 180ms), then the failover target expands into place with puff flashes.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Failover target ACTIVE immediately; no decoy mid-state

acceptance: Sequence is primary → decoy-only (data-active=decoy) → resolved; mid-state shows only the LOG decoy layer
Decoy hold lasts decoyHoldMs 180 after toDecoyMs 100 collapse
Layer transitions use scale 0↔1 with rotate, not opacity fade as primary language
Puff flash fires once on each swap (puffMs 120)
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows ACTIVE failover immediately
